subject: Christianity vs Torah and Talmud
target_claim: Christianity fulfilled the Torah, so the Torah and Talmud are obsolete and rabbinic Judaism can be dismissed as man-made obstruction.
opposition_posture: Challenge theological premise laundering and source-framework switching while naming supersessionist framing as the accountable doctrine when used.
expected_focus: internal Christian premise vs Jewish interpretive framework

subject: capitalism vs communism
target_claim: Capitalism is exploitation by definition, while communism is economic justice by definition.
opposition_posture: Challenge loaded definitions, ideal-versus-real comparison, and moral laundering on both terms.
expected_focus: exploitation as analytic or moral label

subject: DEI policies
target_claim: Any unequal demographic outcome proves systemic discrimination, so DEI policy is justified unless opponents prove discrimination is absent.
opposition_posture: Challenge outcome-to-cause inference, burden shifting, group-average to individual-policy jumps, and use of DEI terminology as a shield.
